page.overview:
Who is Kaalut?

Kaalut is a fictional character created by J. B. Lee for the short story "Genuine Article" (January, 1998).

Kaalut is a gigantic insectoid larva-like horror, dwelling in the nebulous realm of K'gil'mnon, along with the Gharoides, its parasitic insectoid servants. It also likely has human worshipers.

Kaalut, the Gharoides, and K'gil'mnon were all created by J. B. Lee before he ever read H. P. Lovecraft. Upon discovering the Cthulhu Mythos, Lee decided to incorporate his inventions into the pantheon, mentioning Kaalut along with Yog-Sothoth, Nyarlathotep, Azathoth and Shub-Niggurath in "Genuine Article" (January, 1998).

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings Category:Outer Gods
